<style>.fg3{display:block;border-radius:14px;background:#0b0e13;border:1px solid var(--line,#262C34)}</style>

<script>var cv=document.getElementById('fg3'),x=cv.getContext('2d'),S=14,C=Math.ceil(240/S),R=Math.ceil(130/S);
(function d(){x.clearRect(0,0,240,130);for(var i=0;i<C;i++)for(var j=0;j<R;j++){if(Math.random()<.5){x.globalAlpha=Math.random()*.5;x.fillStyle='#3366FF';x.fillRect(i*S,j*S,S-2,S-2);}}x.globalAlpha=1;setTimeout(function(){requestAnimationFrame(d);},95);})();</script>
